news.body: Received the Best Student Paper Award (Sole Recipient (1st place) & $800 USD) at the 2026 IEEE Wireless Power Technology Conference & Expo (WPTCE 2026)!
Awarded the IEEE MTT-S Student Travel Grant for the 2026 IEEE Wireless Power Technology Conference & Expo (WPTCE 2026), valued at $1,000 USD!
Journal accepted in IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques (TMTT)!
Joined research project of LIG D&A for calibration of ultra-large-scale digital array antennas for space surveillance radar!
Selected as the Scholarship Recipient for Samsung Electronics Device Solution (DS), Foundry Division!
Journal accepted in IEEE Open Journal of Antennas and Propagation (OJAP)!
Journal accepted in IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation (TAP)!
Journal accepted in IEEE Antennas and Wireless Propagation Letters (AWPL)!
